title: Digital Rhetorical Ecosystem Analysis: Sensemaking of Digital Memetic Discourse
description: Integrates frameworks from rhetorical studies and ecological studies to catalog, monitor, and study digital image meme data, introducing the Digital Rhetorical Ecosystem three-tiered model (DRE3) for tracing multimedia rhetorical artifacts across platforms, media types, and languages.
abstract: This paper develops a case for integrating rhetorical and ecological frameworks to study digital image memes and their role in disseminating online narratives. Building on the DRE3 model, we analyze how memes function as rhetorical artifacts that shape public discourse through parsimony, polysemy, and identity construction in digital public spheres.
key_findings: Parsimony and polysemy give image memes narrative power
Image memes engage audiences through identity construction
DRE3 model supports formal tracing of memes across platforms
